name: Encrypted Rune
summary: The Encrypted Rune is a coded missive delivered to aspiring rogues taking their first steps in Coldridge Valley. Passed along by Sten Stoutarm, the etched message directs promising shadows into Anvilmar to report to the rogue trainer, Solm Hargrin.

sections.title: A Message in Code
sections.body: While assisting Sten Stoutarm out in the snowy passes of Coldridge Valley, sharp-eyed rogues receive a curious etched stone. Sten admits the piece was slipped to him to hand over, suspecting it came directly from Solm Hargrin. Rather than shouting out across the courtyard for potential scouts and scoundrels, Solm uses an encrypted rune to test a novice's discretion and summon them indoors.

sections.title: Under Anvilmar's Rafters
sections.body: Inside Anvilmar, Solm Hargrin welcomes newly arrived operatives to the craft. He offers to teach the maneuvers, strikes, and subtle arts that keep an operative breathing and lining their pockets with coin. Beyond sharpening their daggers, Solm reminds dwarven rogues to look out for their displaced gnomish allies, who are still recovering from the catastrophic fall of Gnomeregan.

faq.answer: The rune is authored by Solm Hargrin, the rogue trainer stationed inside the great hall of Anvilmar. He has Sten Stoutarm discreetly pass it along to promising recruits out in the snow.

faq.q: Where do I find Solm Hargrin?
faq.answer: Solm Hargrin is located inside the main hall of Anvilmar, the stone bastion at the center of Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this rune?
faq.answer: It serves as an introductory summons for novice rogues, encouraging them to decode the message, report to their class trainer, and begin learning advanced combat techniques and survival maneuvers.

faq.q: Why does Solm mention the gnomes?
faq.answer: With Gnomeregan recently fallen to disaster, gnomish refugees share Coldridge Valley and Anvilmar with the dwarves. Solm reminds his students that the gnomes have had a rough time and need support settling into their temporary home.

faq.q: Who gives the rune to the player?
faq.answer: Sten Stoutarm hands the stone over to rogue adventurers in Coldridge Valley after they finish lending him an initial hand with local valley tasks.

faq.q: Can other classes receive this rune?
faq.answer: No. The Encrypted Rune is intended solely for rogue initiates starting their journeys in Coldridge Valley.

angles.text: This rune marks your first formal contact with the rogue network in Dun Morogh, leading you to Solm Hargrin to begin honing your stealth, martial tricks, and survival trade.
Solm welcomes fellow dwarves of the Ironforge clan into the shadows, noting there is nothing quite like a cold blade and the dark to keep an operative alive in Dun Morogh.
Solm urges his students to show camaraderie to the gnomes sheltering in Coldridge Valley following the tragic loss of their home in Gnomeregan.
